note: The SALR backlog for the UAT and regression demonstrations. Each story is a real Saleor behaviour; most criteria name things the repository's pytest suite already tests (saleor/<package>/tests), and each story keeps one or two criteria that only a person can check in the storefront or dashboard, so the flows have cases to draft, run and sign off.

stories.summary: Vouchers apply to the checkout total and are refused below the minimum spend
stories.description: Voucher discounts on a checkout (saleor/checkout/utils.py, get_voucher_discount_for_checkout) and voucher validity rules (saleor/discount/utils). Entire-order, specific-product and shipping vouchers; minimum spent amount; apply-once-per-order; usage counters.
acceptanceCriteria: A percentage voucher of type entire order reduces the checkout value by the discount for the checkout; the entire order voucher is not applicable when the checkout has no eligible lines.

A voucher with a minimum spent amount is valid only when the checkout subtotal reaches it; when the minimum spent amount is not reached the checkout keeps its price and the API answers that the voucher is not applicable.
A specific products voucher with apply once per order discounts only the cheapest eligible line once.
A shipping voucher applies to the shipping price for all countries or only its limited countries, and is not applicable when delivery is missing or not required.
Removing the voucher code from the checkout restores the total and decreases the voucher usage; adding it again increases the voucher usage.
In the storefront the order summary shows a discount line with the voucher code and the amount saved, and the line disappears when the code is removed.

stories.summary: Gift card codes are added to a checkout and refused when inactive, expired, in another currency or used up
stories.description: Adding and removing gift card codes on a checkout (saleor/giftcard/utils.py: add_gift_card_code_to_checkout, remove_gift_card_code_from_checkout) and the checks on the card: active, not expired, same currency as the checkout, balance left.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid gift card code is added to the checkout and reduces the amount to pay by the card's balance.
Adding an inactive gift card code to the checkout is refused with a clear error.
Adding an expired gift card code to the checkout is refused with a clear error.
Adding a gift card code with an invalid currency for the checkout is refused.
Adding a used gift card code (no balance left) to the checkout is refused.
Removing a gift card code from the checkout restores the amount to pay; removing from a checkout with no gift cards changes nothing.
A gift card added to the checkout before the customer email is set stays on the checkout and is applied once the email is provided.

stories.summary: Gift cards are issued with the shop's expiry settings and can be bought in the checkout
stories.description: Creating gift cards (saleor/giftcard/utils.py: gift_cards_create, calculate_expiry_settings) from shop settings: expiry date or never expire, several cards at once, webhook on creation; buying a gift card product in the checkout issues the card to the customer.
acceptanceCriteria: Gift cards create sets the expiry date from the shop's expiry settings (expiry period or fixed date).
With never expire settings the created gift card has no expiry date.
Gift cards create with a quantity above one issues that many cards with distinct codes and triggers the gift card created webhook once per card.
Buying a gift card product in the checkout issues the gift card to the order's customer and the code is sent in the gift card notification email.
The customer sees the issued gift card in the account page with its current balance and expiry date.

stories.summary: Stock is reserved for a checkout and the reservation fails when stock is not enough
stories.description: Stock reservations for checkout lines (saleor/warehouse/reservations.py: reserve_stocks) with the warehouse allocation strategies, existing order allocations and the reservation timeout.
acceptanceCriteria: Reserve stocks creates a reservation for each checkout line in a warehouse of the checkout's shipping zone, replacing the previous reservations for the checkout.
Stock reservation fails if there is not enough stock available across the warehouses, and fails if there is no stock at all.
Multiple stocks are reserved if a single stock is not enough, following the highest stock strategy or the sorting order strategy of the channel.
Stock reservation accounts for order allocations and existing reservations of other checkouts, so the same unit is never promised twice.
Once a reservation times out the quantity is available again and the storefront shows the product as in stock within the reservation length set for the channel.

stories.summary: Refunding fulfilled products creates a refund fulfillment, with or without shipping costs
stories.description: Refunds of an order's products (saleor/order/actions.py: create_refund_fulfillment): order lines, fulfillment lines, shipping costs included, a custom amount; the order's payment is refunded and the customer notified.
acceptanceCriteria: Create refund fulfillment for only order lines moves the lines to a refunded fulfillment and refunds their total.
Create refund fulfillment with included shipping costs adds the shipping price to the refunded amount.
Create refund fulfillment for only fulfillment lines refunds those lines and reduces the fulfillment's quantities.
Create refund fulfillment with a custom amount refunds exactly that amount, not more than what was paid.
After a refund the customer receives the order refunded email naming the refunded products and the amount.
The dashboard's order page shows the refunded amount and the balance still captured.

stories.summary: Payments need a billing address, carry the checkout's metadata, and failed charges are recorded
stories.description: Creating payments and payment information (saleor/payment/utils.py: create_payment, create_payment_information) for a checkout or an order, and what the gateway layer records when a charge fails (saleor/payment/gateway.py).
acceptanceCriteria: Create payment requires an order or a checkout; creating one from a checkout without a billing address is refused.
Payment information for a checkout payment carries the checkout token, the customer email and the checkout metadata.
A gateway charge that failed is recorded as a failed transaction with the gateway's error message, and errors from the gateway do not change the amount captured.
Completing a checkout with an active transaction creates an order marked as paid; with an inactive payment the order is created unpaid.
A checkout completed with a partial payment creates a partially paid order and the dashboard shows the amount still due.

stories.summary: A customer's address book keeps at most the allowed number of addresses and reuses existing ones
stories.description: Storing addresses from a completed checkout in the customer's address book (saleor/account/utils.py: store_user_address, is_user_address_limit_reached, remove_the_oldest_user_address) and the checkout's save-address flags.
acceptanceCriteria: Is user address limit reached answers true at the limit and false below it.
Store user address uses the existing one when the same address is already in the book, even when it is duplicated, and creates a new address only when none matches.
When the address limit is reached, storing a new address removes the oldest user address first.
Checkout complete stores the shipping and billing address in the customer's addresses after the address was updated during the checkout.
Checkout complete respects the saving address settings: with save address off, the address is not added to the address book.
Email addresses are matched without case sensitivity when a customer signs in or is looked up.

stories.summary: Variant prices honour channel overrides and discounts, and product media can be removed
stories.description: Variant pricing per channel listing (saleor/product/utils: get_price with an overridden price, with and without a discount), percentage and fixed discounts (saleor/discount), deleting product media, and bulk deletion of vouchers by staff.
acceptanceCriteria: Get price returns the overridden price of the channel listing when no discount applies.
Get price with an overridden price and a discount applies the discount to the overridden price.
Percentage discounts and fixed discounts are computed on the price and never below zero.
Product media delete removes the media and its thumbnails and the product no longer lists it.
Staff can delete vouchers in bulk from the dashboard and the deleted codes no longer apply to a checkout.
The storefront shows the original price struck through next to the discounted price on the product page.
